title: Weeloysen qaleelak farmoyti.
intro: Dumaahi Qarab baaxok qilsi sacarah addal, qaadik yan gabâ taamah yamixxige marih fanat inki num yooboke. ken buxaaxi maqar le xaak ugutte, uxih ken sorkoco baxi gibduk suge qaleelak oson weeloysen. Diini farmoyti inki, miraaciini asta luk temeete — takkay immay, kaxxaam kee giclo sissik kee bohoy le xalootu. atu baxxaaqissam duuddaa massakaxxa le taama abeyna kay ummatta doorteh finqa miracsenta?
clues: Anu inni ummattah maabitinah ruubeeh, Inki Yallih qibaadah ken seeca.
Yi ummatta diraamaatik xaahih bicih fanat mannowta, qaleeli exxaaxil qaxmeqe sigmah buxaaxi weeloysak sugte.
assakat le is- gaali yi dooqah uddur maqar le xaak yewqe, qado asta inkih yan numuk.
Anu inni ummattah lee ta gaali lih tabaatabsaanam kee tet mabiyaaka exce.
Yi ummatta is-gaali qagitak massoysen kee tet qanxix, sinni finqah muhri.
bohoy le ardi angoyyi yi ummattat radeeh, oson sinni buxaaxil angagoyyi sinnim raden.
arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
